summary: Tested new Demo Leads admin feature (backend + frontend). 10/10 pytest tests pass; frontend flows all verified via Playwright: admin-only route protection, tab filtering with counts, PATCH status update with toast, /admin 'Manage all' link, and public /contact form regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact form <input> and <textarea> elements lack data-testid attributes on /contact page (name/email/message/submit). Not blocking, but recommended for testability per project convention.

DemoLeads.jsx: counts memo initializes closed count to 0 but if a lead has an unknown status string, it silently adds a new key — safe today given regex-constrained backend, but consider defensive default.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed leads via POST /api/contact during pytest run. Left in contact_messages (per main agent note demo data is fine).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo Leads feature (GET/PATCH /api/admin/leads, /demo-leads page, admin/Leads Inbox 'Manage all' link) fully verified in iteration_22. New pytest file test_demo_leads.py covers admin auth, status filter, PATCH transitions, invalid status 422, 404, 403 for non-admin/unauth. Backend runs pytest via `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_demo_leads.py -o addopts=''` (need to override xdist for module-scoped fixture sharing).
